diffuse_brightening.formula: For each sRGB byte independently: round(255 * (input / 255) ** 0.75)
diffuse_brightening.input: Preserved pre-brightening JPEG at each texture's brightening_baseline path; always regenerate from this baseline, never compound
diffuse_brightening.output: RGB JPEG, original dimensions, Pillow quality=95, subsampling=0
diffuse_brightening.scope: 63 imported diffuse skins across 27 Q2 models; no normalmaps, materials, configs or source originals changed

emissive_glow.method: Glow textures keep only the lit features of the brightened diffuse skin, in their own colour on black: a hue-dominance, saturation or brightness mask, optionally limited to hand-picked UV regions, scaled by a gain and given a small Gaussian halo. RGB JPEG, quality 95, subsampling 0.
emissive_glow.self_emissive: Surfaces whose skin is already a light (stimpack glow/pulse/fluid, large health blood, shotgun glow/glow2/glowpulse, chaingun sidelight, railgun lights, machinegun screen, BFG energy) use their own diffuse as the glow stage texture.
emissive_glow.naming: stimpack uses _fx because stimpack_glow is an existing surface skin.
emissive_glow.material_stage: blend src_alpha one, pulse 2 for health, 1 for megahealth/cells/armor/quad, 1.5 for adrenaline, 0.5-1.25 for weapons

weapons/quake2_chaingun.operation: Rebuilt the six 8-sided barrel tubes and muzzle caps with 24 sides; subdivided the two 12-sided clamp rings and their side discs to 36 sides
weapons/quake2_chaingun.notes: Barrels: per-end center and mean corner radius are kept, so bounds are unchanged. Tube U is interpolated by angle between the original corners from each end's texture seam; caps use an affine fit of the original cap UVs. Clamps: a closed Catmull-Rom curve through the original (irregular) corners adds two points per edge, keeping every original corner position and UV; band V is interpolated along each edge; side discs use an affine fit of the original disc UVs (residual within 1/320 source quantization). Tube and band normals follow the new surface; cap and disc normals, and all windings, follow the original. All other surfaces are unchanged.

weapons/quake2_supershotgun.operation: Subdivided the two 10-sided barrels (outer shells, inner bores, muzzle face plates and the one closed bore breech cap) 3x to 30 sides
weapons/quake2_supershotgun.notes: Cross-sections follow a closed Catmull-Rom curve through the original corners; the axial coordinate (the curved muzzle crown) is linear between corners, so bounds are unchanged. Every original corner keeps its position and UV. Face plates and the cap take UVs from an affine fit of the originals and keep their normals. All other surfaces are unchanged.

diffuse_regeneration.input: Each texture's brightening_baseline, or its edited_baseline when hand edited after brightening; never compound
steps: Remove baked specular (strong) with {'glint_size': 0.03, 'streak': 0.2, 'percentile': 25, 'keep': 0.0, 'saturation': 0.35}, only within texels used by the mesh
diffuse_regeneration.skipped: Lights/glow sources (specular_removal: light) and textures no surface uses (unused) are only brightened
diffuse_regeneration.output: RGB JPEG, original dimensions, Pillow quality=95, subsampling=0; RGBA PNG where a texture specifies alpha (smoothstep of the brightest channel)
diffuse_regeneration.status: User chose strong removal for all Q2 item skins, without brightness compensation; needs in-game review
